summary: The Runware Grant Program awards up to $30,000 in API credits usable over 12 months across Runware's production platform — image, video, image/video editing, audio, LLMs, 3D, and avatar models on one API. For early-stage teams (before Series A; bootstrapped welcome) with a real product or credible MVP, building or launching on Runware within six months, reachable at a business email. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis within two weeks; no equity taken.
claim_steps: Submit the grant form at https://runware.ai/grant-program with product, stage, traction, and expected Runware usage.
Eligibility: pre-Series A or bootstrapped, credible MVP, business email, building/launching within 6 months.
Reviewed within 2 weeks; approved grants receive API credits on your Runware account.
